column1: # Figure 1. Study design. Two parameter classes form a registry of configurations per task. Each configuration's minimum-over-knobs peak of requested PyTorch CPU tensor bytes decides feasibility under seven caps and an unbounded control. Within each class the best feasible configuration on validation (seed 0) is selected per task and cap and confirmed on test (seeds 1–10
column2: plus one top-up of seeds 11–12); the frozen judge compares the difference with preregistered floors (A1). In parallel
column3: a lifetime-aware accounting predicts each configuration's peak before any registry measurement (A2). Drawn by a Python script (matplotlib 3.11.2) written with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 (model identifier claude-opus-5-5).
